page.overview:
Who is Benito Sangiovesi?

Benito Sangiovesi, is the restaurantuer of the tavern "Il Taverna Tauro Rosso" (The Red Bull Tavern) of Kreutzhofen in Wissenland.

Recently. some of the sindicalistas have begun patronising the Black Eagle Inn of Kreutzhofen in Wissenland. This began when Benito Sangiovesi was forced to close his restaurant temporarily owing to illness. and the habit has lasted - the Tileans have acquired a taste for the Eagle's board of fare.

But in reality, Benito was not sick, he was taken prisoner by the Sindicalistas, once freed he left the city in search of his kidnapped brother, Guido Sangiovesi.

Then Benito hired a group of adventurers to bring him home before he could be brought to Miragliano to be executed by the Cornuti family, due to an old feud for the control of the city. After a successful rescue, he organized one last party in his tavern and then left with his "brother" - his loyalty is to the Fulvini, and as one of the last surviving sergeants of that family, he can't allow the rightful Duke of Miragliano to go into the world without a single follower.
